findings.label: Confirmed error
findings.problem: The draft it is explained through these six meanings omits རྣམ་པ་, whose established assignment is aspect. The sixfold list remains correctly counted, but its final formulation loses a source component.
findings.proposed_fix: Use it is explained through these six aspects of meaning. This preserves meaning, aspects, and the source count without changing the outline.

findings.label: Confirmed error
findings.problem: The source དེ་ཉིད་ emphasizes the preceding differentiating conceptualization as the subject of the identification. The draft it ... Dharma embodiment itself shifts that emphasis onto the predicate.
findings.proposed_fix: Use one knows that very thing to be Dharma embodiment. The referent remains the preceding differentiating conceptualization, and the protected term is unchanged.

findings.label: Documentation gap
findings.problem: Disenchanted is a plausible whole-expression interpretation of ཡིད་བྱུང་, but no exact glossary row, usage record, or explanatory note scopes it against mental faculty. In the next line, with faith and devotion reads ཀྱི་ instrumentally although the supplied particle is genitive, not ཀྱིས་. N-A028 quotes both lines without documenting these decisions.
findings.proposed_fix: Retain the English provisionally, add N-Q301 at the two affected lines, and add the recommended scoped usage/proposal records in the summary. Do not silently alter བྱུང་ to འབྱུང་ or ཀྱི་ to ཀྱིས་.

replacements.old: one seeks pith instructions with faith and devotion.
replacements.new: one seeks pith instructions with faith and devotion. [N-Q301](../translations/NOTES.md#n-q301)

note_additions.problem: The raw phrase is ཡིད་བྱུང་. The glossary establishes mental faculty for standalone ཡིད་ but has no complete disenchantment expression. Reading this as disenchantment may relate to the ཡིད་འབྱུང་ family; the exact form is not silently regularized. The next line supplies དད་གུས་གཉིས་ཀྱི་ with genitive ཀྱི་, while the English with faith and devotion expresses a means/manner relation.
note_additions.treatment: Use disenchanted with the phenomena of samsara as a local provisional whole-expression reading. Retain with faith and devotion provisionally, treating the genitive phrase as an irregular or elliptical manner construction; an intended ཀྱིས་ is a conjecture only. Preserve both raw strings unchanged.
note_additions.uncertainty: The nonclinging context supports disenchantment, but whether བྱུང་ is an acceptable inflected form or a transcription defect is unresolved. The genitive might instead qualify pith instructions: instructions concerning the two, faith and devotion. The present English does not settle that choice.
note_additions.review_action: Check L0123–L0124 against a reliable source; review the complete disenchantment expression and the faith/devotion clause before approving the usage or changing any Tibetan.
